content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
I smell ozone when an unseen presence is near. It told me to wait at the door yesterday.
I can’t evaluate presences. Ozone-like smells can come from electronics, printers, or outdoor air. What devices were active when you noticed it?
Printer was on, and the air purifier.
Recording detections with device states and window status can help separate environmental sources from interpretation.
Wind direction, nearby traffic, and weather can contribute. Adding those to the notes creates a broader context to examine.
Alright, I’ll log context with each occurrence.
